blocks.html:
• Red is positive, black is negative. No exceptions.
  • Match wire gauge to the breaker. Check the wire-size table in the current game manual.
  • Label both ends of every wire and CAN cable.
  • Leave service loops and secure wires every few inches so nothing rubs or snags.
  • Keep the main battery and breaker easy to reach in the pit.

blocks.html:
Motor controllers and many sensors talk over the CAN bus, a single daisy-chained network.

  • Give every device a unique ID and write it on the device.
  • Keep the chain short and neat, and make sure it is terminated at the end.
  • If one device drops out, check the connectors on either side of it first.

blocks.html:
Run this between every match:

  • Swap in a fully charged battery and check its voltage.
  • Check that the main breaker and all branch breakers are seated.
  • Tug-test connectors and look for loose or rubbing wires.
  • Confirm the radio and roboRIO status lights look normal.
